accepted: Strict full-panel verdict remains false for27 exact integer differences; no tolerance or threshold change.
Bind newly generated reports to comparer/helper SHA256 and recipe SHA256.
Compare episode start/end source timestamps exactly.

scope_decisions: Attribute channels are optional by production contract; do not globally require every sensor to have intensity/ring/time. Full raw-message benchmark independently verifies availability on this actual panel.
Historical reporting schema is intentionally replaced with explicit schema_version2; no in-repo programmatic consumers were found. Existing reports are never overwritten.
No unsupported deskew/Linux/generated-layout result is claimed.
The counter is decision-coupled in general, so adjacent-case stability is not a universal safety argument.
rejected_reasoning: A floor-voxel count can change under an arbitrarily small coordinate perturbation at a boundary; the review claim that a semantic change requires half a voxel is false.
The upstream repeat uses the identical already-built native binary; it is not a new-build control.
The exact source of pose non-repeatability is not established by source inspection; thread/reduction order remains a hypothesis until stronger measurement.
